description: Oluganda lwe lulimi lwa Buganda wakati mu Uganda, era lwogerwa abantu bukadde na bukadde mu Kampala n’okumpi nayo.

why.title: Olulimi lw’**enguudo za Kampala.**
why.text: Oluganda lwogerwa abantu bukadde na bukadde wakati mu Uganda, era lwe lulimi olusinga okwogerwa mu Kampala. Luyige oyogere n’ab’omu maka, ofune emikwano mu katale, era owulire ng’oli waka ku lugendo lwo oluddako.

cards.title: Eri ab’omu maka
cards.text: Ddayo eri bajjajja era oyigirize abaana olulimi.

cards.title: Eri abatambuze
cards.text: Lamusa, sala ebbeeyi era otambule n’obwesige.

landing.audience: Abatandika okuva ku ntandikwa, ab’omu maka ababeera ebweru abaagala okuddayo eri olulimi, n’abagenyi abajja mu Uganda abaagala ebisingawo ku “oli otya”.
landing.first: Okulamusa, okweyanjula n’ennamba, oluvannyuma ab’omu maka, emmere, akatale, obudde, ebifo n’ebirala, ekitundu ku kitundu.
